premises.text: Charisma is a mobile location-based real-time video messenger for spontaneous calls with people nearby and existing contacts
Signup pre-populates Facebook/Twitter profile and friends, and also surfaces nearby people outside the existing social graph
premises.evidence_span: we pre-populate your profile with your existing data from Facebook and Twitter

premises.text: Sparks encourage a callback when someone is reluctant to place the first call
premises.evidence_span: you can actually send them a spark to encourage them to call you back

premises.text: Open profiles, distance, and age filters let people see who someone is before calling
premises.evidence_span: You can immediately see open profiles of people, see who they are before calling them

premises.text: Initially ads-based with a subscription to turn off ads
premises.evidence_span: we are initially ads-based with a subscription to turn out the ads

value.text: Easy spontaneous real-time interaction with people nearby without old-school dating-site friction
value.evidence_span: how easy it is to reach people nearby using Charisma

causal_links.evidence_span: ads-based with a subscription to turn out the ads

notes: Nearby store/bar calling uses folded as applications of same messenger (§4.1.2). Dating-site questionnaire contrast folded into value. Live stage demos are product evidence, not traction metrics.
